pr_title: server: fix the missing detachment for the mem/disk tracker
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:

2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
Currently, we detach session tracker from global tracker in `CloseRecordSet` function. If the query have no `RecordSet` returned (eg: `insert`), the session tracker won't be detached from global tracker which would cause the inaccurate memory usage statistical information.


Issue Number: close #17420 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

### What is changed and how it works?

How it Works:

If the ExecuteStmt have no result returned in the `handleQuery`, we will directly detach the tracker

issue_context.title: Detach memory tracker for insert/update
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Currently, for the session memory tracker, it won't detach from the global memory tracker for `insert` and `update` which would cause the inaccurate memory usage statistical information. We need to detach the memory tracker in these cases.
